invitation.subject: {inviter} invited you to Clozer
invitation.body: You'll join the “{workspace}” workspace: your proposals, who reads them, and when to follow up.
invitation.footer: Link valid for 7 days. Not expecting this? Ignore this email.

welcome.subject: Welcome to Clozer
welcome.title: Just one thing to do
welcome.body: Drop in a document (quote, invoice, deck, anything), then open the link the way your prospect would. You'll see right away what Clozer shows you. Two minutes.
welcome.noInstall: Nothing to install, it all happens in your browser.

noDocument.subject: Your first document on Clozer
noDocument.title: Take the last document you sent
noDocument.body: Even an old one. Drop it into Clozer and open the link: you'll see exactly what your prospect will see, and what you'll learn from their read.
noDocument.example: No document at hand? An example is waiting for you.

notSent.subject: Your link is ready, it hasn't gone out yet
notSent.title: Your link is waiting for its prospect
notSent.body: Paste it into your next email, instead of the attachment. As soon as your prospect opens it, you'll know.

firstRead.subject: {label} opened your document
firstRead.body: Your first link was read. On the deal page: the pages read, the time spent, and what Clozer makes of it.
firstRead.followup: If a follow-up would help, Clozer writes it for you. It waits in “Follow-ups to review”, nothing goes out without you.

outlookConnected.subject: Outlook connected to your Clozer account
outlookConnected.intro: An Outlook was just connected to your Clozer account ({when}).
outlookConnected.ifYou: If that was you, nothing to do.
outlookConnected.otherwise: Otherwise, revoke it right away in Settings › Chrome and Outlook: {url}
outlookConnected.otherwiseHtml: Otherwise, revoke it right away in Settings › Chrome and Outlook.
